ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Allow HiveWard to use the camera for QR code scanning.
ios.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: HiveWard connects to the desktop app on your LAN.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Allow HiveWard to use your microphone for voice dictation sent to your paired desktop for transcription.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Allow HiveWard to attach photos from your library to a terminal session on your paired desktop.
